'''Hurdenn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Hurdenn was an important officer in the Imperial military hierarchy during the Cold War, who is most notable for commanding the Sith Empire's operations on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] operations on Taris sought to defeat the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] and restore Taris to its former glory, to provide an example of the Republic's resolve to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Hurdenn was responsible for overseeing Imperial efforts to undermine and defeat the Republic there.

Eventually, Hurdenn allied with [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] in order to see the Republic's [[Republic Strategic High Command|War Trust]] generals killed. Once [[Destruction of the War Trust|the mission]] was completed, Hurdenn released his subordinate [[Pierce|Lieutenant Pierce]] into the Warrior's command.
